name: Uniswap V3 Factory (Base)
not_assessed: how many keys it takes to move it
the time anyone has to react
the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a confirmed delay, bypass paths checked

narrative.summary: The cleanest-verified L1-DAO-via-bridge case in this whole project: an explicit, readable storage slot names the canonical OP-stack cross-domain messenger, not an address that has to be reverse-derived.
narrative.detail: This scorer deliberately opens its own separate Ethereum-mainnet RPC connection to independently re-confirm the real Uniswap Governance Timelock’s delay() and admin() live, rather than trusting a prior note - contrast the Arbitrum case elsewhere in this project, which has to reverse an address-derived bridge alias instead of reading an explicit slot.
